package kewrchess_v2

import (
	"gno.land/p/g1g7dna0gp4nec5rza4q25htj0cjgswrxefp37ep/chess"
)

// Game represents an on-chain chess game session
type Game struct {
	id            int
	white         address              // Wallet address of White player
	black         address              // Wallet address of Black player
	board         chess.Board          // 8x8 chess board from package chess
	isWhiteTurn   bool                 // True = White's turn, False = Black's turn
	status        string               // "PLAYING", "WHITE_WON", "BLACK_WON", "DRAW"
	castling      chess.CastlingRights // Castling rights for White & Black
	enPassantCol  int                  // Pawn column vulnerable to en passant (-1 if none)
	drawOfferedBy address              // Address of player offering a draw ("" if none)
	resignedBy        address              // Address of player who resigned ("" if none)
	settledBy         address              // Address of player who recorded final settlement on blockchain ("" if not yet)

	// Anti-Cheat Protection: Proposal & Challenge Period
	proposedBy        address              // Player submitting victory claim
	pendingStatus     string               // Proposed settlement status ("WHITE_WON", "BLACK_WON", "DRAW")
	challengeDeadline int64                // Unix timestamp deadline for challenging settlement proposal
	
	// Anti-RageQuit Protection: Timeout & Abandonment
	turnDeadline      int64                // Unix timestamp deadline for opponent's turn response
	turnChallengedBy  address              // Player demanding turn response due to AFK opponent
}

// NewGame initializes a new game with the standard chess starting layout
func NewGame(id int, white, black address) *Game {
	return &Game{
		id:                id,
		white:             white,
		black:             black,
		board:             chess.NewInitialBoard(),
		isWhiteTurn:       true,
		status:            "PLAYING",
		castling:          chess.CastlingRights{},
		enPassantCol:      -1,
		drawOfferedBy:     "",
		resignedBy:        "",
		settledBy:         "",
		proposedBy:        "",
		pendingStatus:     "",
		challengeDeadline: 0,
		turnDeadline:      0,
		turnChallengedBy:  "",
	}
}

## Networks We Are Currently Validating & AuM:

Perfect Nodes provides infrastructure and validator services across multiple blockchain ecosystems. We currently operate validators and node infrastructure for networks including: 
- Provenance: 45M HASH 
- Starknet: 15.86М STRK
- Espresso: 3M ESP
- DoraVota: 4M DORA
- Ika: 64M IKA
- Haqq: 8M ISLM
- Uptick: 2M UPTICK
- Near: 40K NEAR
- Canton, Cosmos and other

## Links to Our Digital Presence:

- Website: https://perfect-nodes.com
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/perfect_nodes

## Contact Details:

- Telegram: https://t.me/perfect_nodes
- Discord: katekrasv

## Why We Are Interested in Validating on gno.land:

Perfect-nodes has been validating across multiple networks for several years, and we usually prefer to get involved early in strong ecosystems and stay in for the long term. gno.land stands out to us because of its team and the direction the project is taking, which makes it a good fit.

Our focus is simple — run a stable and reliable validator and contribute to the network beyond block production. This includes providing public RPC and snapshots, participating in governance, and supporting other validators and users where we can.

We plan to stay long-term and keep a reliable validator running as gno.land grows.

## Contributions to gno.land:

- Testnet participation
- Public RPC, API, and snapshot services
- Development operational tools
- Guides
- Validator operations and upgrade support
